plan: SnapCanvas performance — capture + editor hot paths (behavior-preserving)
method: headless-Chrome harnesses (harness/): editor-pixel.mjs (export golden + move burst), scan-eq.mjs (scan equivalence + timing), pipeline.mjs (full-page capture end-to-end on a synthetic 12-row page), move-bench.mjs (large-canvas move burst)

medianMs_20kElements.note: within noise (x0.91-1.07 across runs); per-node getComputedStyle is irreducible without changing semantics
